description: This file defines a client-side React component 'ProjectsList' that displays a list of projects and includes functionality to create new projects via a modal form. It manages state for modal visibility, form submission, and error handling, and interacts with server-side actions to create projects.

methods.name: ProjectsList
methods.description: Main React functional component that renders the project list and create project modal, managing form interactions and state transitions.

methods.name: onCreateSubmit
methods.description: Event handler for the project creation form submission, handles API interaction, error handling, and modal state updates.
